Name: Stardew Access
Author: TheOneWhoKnocks003
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=5][b][center][size=6]Stardew Access[/size][/center][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia]

[/font][font=Georgia][left]Stardew Access is a [url=https://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url] mod that focuses on making the game blind accessible for windows, linux and mac.
The mod uses the [url=https://github.com/ndarilek/tolk]Tolk[/url] library on windows, [url=https://github.com/khanshoaib3/libspeechdwrapper]libspeechdwrapper[/url] on linux and [url=https://github.com/Flameborn/libspeak]libspeak[/url] on mac for interacting with the active screen reader.
The mod adds several features to help the player gather information regarding the surrounding and the player.
It also patches the various menus and the fishing mini-game (more mini-games will be patched soon) to make them accessible.[/left]
Checkout the [url=https://github.com/khanshoaib3/stardew-access/]mod's wiki[/url] for the setup and other info. And go here for [url=https://github.com/khanshoaib3/stardew-access/wiki]dev wiki[/url].

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Stardew_Valley_Wiki]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url] - has guides and info for everything in Stardew Valley though some things may not be accessible.[/font]
[*][font=Georgia][url=https://github.com/khanshoaib3/stardew-access/issues]Issues[/url] - post any bug or feature request here.[/font]

[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]

Follow [url=https://github.com/khanshoaib3/stardew-access/issues/182]this[/url] issue page to track the progress of
translations currently in the works and/or if you want to provide translation for your language.

[/font]
